zh-CN.heading: 看看你的行业，可以从哪里开始
zh-CN.intro: 选择接近你业务的行业，从一件费时的工作开始。下面是可讨论的场景，相关案例注明实际做过的部分。

service_labels.fde-consulting: 看 AI 实施合作方式

zh-CN.contact_hint: 说说现在怎么做、哪一步最费时间即可，不用准备方案。实施范围和费用确认后再开始。

items.name: 制造业
items.summary: 库存反复核对，产品与操作资料不好找
items.detail: 可以从一次盘点或一份规格表开始，梳理哪里重复录入、哪里查找费时。涉及生产设备或现有系统对接时，另行评估。
items.case_note: 洁具企业库存项目可供流程参考，完成范围见案例。

items.name: 电子商务
items.summary: 商品资料反复整理，客服总答同样的问题
items.detail: 可以先选一类商品，把商品说明和常见问题放在一起，看看如何让客服查资料、核对答案更方便。先评估现有平台和工具，再决定做法。

items.name: 跨境电商
items.summary: 中英文产品资料难维护，海外咨询反复回复
items.detail: 可以先选一个产品，看看中英文说明是否一致、哪些咨询反复出现，再讨论资料维护或客服辅助中的一个改进。
items.case_note: 以下案例仅对应海外品牌营销与客服协作，具体职责见详情。

items.name: 批发与零售
items.summary: 进出库重复登记，单据与库存对不上
items.detail: 可以拿一笔收货或出货记录，沿着登记、库存变动和核对走一遍，找出重复提交、录错后难修改的步骤。
items.case_note: 案例写明已交付的功能，也说明哪些使用效果尚未核实。

items.name: 家具、家居与建材
items.summary: 型号规格不好找，展示与库存资料难维护
items.detail: 可以先整理一组产品的图片、型号和尺寸，看看官网如何展示、员工如何查找。展示页面、资料维护和库存功能分别确认范围。
items.case_note: 家具品牌展示页面与扫码库存为两个项目，完成范围分别说明。

items.name: 律所与专业服务
items.summary: 客户找服务信息费力，员工查文件费时
items.detail: 可以先看客户能否找到服务说明与咨询入口，或挑一类员工常查的文件梳理查找过程。资料权限和人工确认方式在合作前约定。
items.case_note: 相关经历为团队中的律所官网与内部办公系统开发，分工见详情。

items.name: 品牌与内容工作室
items.summary: 素材到处找，文案配图每次从头做
items.detail: 可以先选一类反复制作的内容，梳理素材存放、文案配图和人工审核步骤，再判断现成工具能帮上哪一部分。
items.case_note: 相关实践为团队品牌营销、内容与 AI 视频协作。

items.name: 公益机构
items.summary: 项目资料难归集，官网内容更新费时
items.detail: 可以先选一个项目，整理介绍、进展和可公开资料，看看如何展示与更新。内容公开范围和后续维护责任先确认。
items.case_note: 相关实践为公益官网开发，具体职责和交付内容见案例。

en.heading: Where could we start in your industry?
en.intro: Choose the industry closest to your business and start with one time-consuming task. These are scenarios we can discuss; linked cases state the work actually done.
en.contact_hint: Just describe how you work now and which step takes the most time. No proposal needed. Implementation starts after scope and fees are agreed.

items.name: Manufacturing
items.summary: Repeated stock checks and hard-to-find product instructions
items.detail: We can start with one stocktake or specification sheet and trace repeated entry or slow lookups. Equipment connections and integrations with existing systems need a separate review.
items.case_note: The sanitaryware inventory project is a workflow reference. Its case states the completed scope.

items.name: E-commerce
items.summary: Reworking product information and answering the same questions
items.detail: We can start with one product category, bring its descriptions and common questions together, and assess how staff could find information and check answers more easily. Your current platform and tools guide the approach.

items.name: Cross-border e-commerce
items.summary: Keeping bilingual product information current and repeating replies
items.detail: We can choose one product, check whether its Chinese and English descriptions agree, and identify recurring questions. Then we can discuss one improvement to information maintenance or support assistance.
items.case_note: These cases cover overseas brand marketing and customer support collaboration. Each states my role.

items.name: Wholesale and retail
items.summary: Repeated stock entries and records that do not match
items.detail: We can trace one receipt or dispatch through entry, stock changes and reconciliation to find duplicate submissions and entries that are difficult to correct.
items.case_note: The case states which functions were delivered and which usage outcomes remain unverified.

items.name: Furniture, home and building products
items.summary: Hard-to-find specifications and product records to maintain
items.detail: We can start with the images, model numbers and dimensions for one product group, then review how customers see them and staff find them. Website presentation, information maintenance and inventory functions have separate scopes.
items.case_note: The furniture presentation site and barcode inventory system are separate projects. Each case states the completed scope.

items.name: Law firms and professional services
items.summary: Clients struggle to find service details; staff spend time finding files
items.detail: We can review how clients find service details and a contact route, or trace how staff find one frequently used type of document. Access permissions and human review are agreed before implementation.
items.case_note: Related work covers law-firm websites and internal office systems within a team. See each case for my responsibilities.

items.name: Brands and content studios
items.summary: Searching for assets and starting copy and images from scratch
items.detail: We can choose one recurring content task, review asset storage, copy, images and human approval, then assess which steps existing tools could help with.
items.case_note: Related experience is collaborative brand marketing, content and AI video work.

items.name: Nonprofit organizations
items.summary: Scattered project records and time-consuming website updates
items.detail: We can start with one project, organize its introduction, progress and public information, then review how it is presented and updated. Disclosure limits and maintenance responsibilities are agreed first.
items.case_note: Related work is nonprofit website development. The case describes my role and the delivered content.
